title: Scalable Question-Centric Text-to-Image Evaluation: Reliable Ranking, Fine-Grained Diagnosis, and Cost-Aware Routing
abstract: arXiv:2608.24112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models often have similar total scores but different strengths, making practical selection difficult. Fine-grained benchmarks decompose prompts into questions, yet often return them to prompt scores and fixed categories, weakening attribution and ignoring complexity. Related requirements are also scored separately or as one total, obscuring basic versus compositional failure. We present QC-T2I-Bench, a question-centric framework that converts open prompts into attributed atomic questions and organizes their dependencies with Davidsonian Scene Graphs (DSGs). We use hierarchy-constrained question aggregation to exclude downstream questions after a prerequisite fails and to prevent simple and complex prompts from receiving the same total weight. We then use the DSG structure to measure joint success within prompts and compare repeated entities across prompts, separating basic realization failures from failures und

translated_title: 可扩展的以问题为中心的文本到图像评估：可靠排名、细粒度诊断与成本感知路由
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24112v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代文本到图像（T2I）模型通常总分相似但各有优势，这使得实际选择变得困难。细粒度基准将提示分解为问题，但往往又将其汇总为提示分数和固定类别，削弱了归因性并忽略了复杂性。相关需求也被单独评分或作为一个总分处理，从而模糊了基本失败与组合失败的区别。我们提出了QC-T2I-Bench，一个以问题为中心的框架，它将开放提示转换为具有归因性的原子问题，并使用戴维森场景图（DSGs）组织它们的依赖关系。我们使用层级约束的问题聚合，在前置问题失败后排除下游问题，并防止简单和复杂提示获得相同的总权重。然后，我们利用DSG结构衡量提示内的联合成功，并跨提示比较重复实体，从而将基本实现失败与更复杂的失败区分开来。
tldr: 本文提出QC-T2I-Bench，一个以问题为中心的框架，通过戴维森场景图组织原子问题的依赖关系，实现可靠排名、细粒度诊断和成本感知路由，有效区分基本与组合失败。
en_tdlr: This paper presents QC-T2I-Bench, a question-centric framework that uses Davidsonian Scene Graphs to organize atomic question dependencies, enabling reliable ranking, fine-grained diagnosis, and cost-aware routing while distinguishing basic from compositional failures.
